rationale: The provided excerpts from EASA NPA 2025-07(B) explicitly confirm the proposed framework includes operational design domain definitions, continuous risk assessment, system development assurance, supervised-ML learning assurance, configuration/life-cycle data management, and in-service monitoring. The claim accurately bounds this as proposed material rather than a final approved lifecycle.
limitations: The framework remains a Notice of Proposed Amendment (NPA), relies on unfinalized standards (e.g., ED-324/ARP6983), and explicitly excludes systems directly contributing to fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries.
